title: 4. Proudly True
slide_intent: Allow human and material imperfections to remain visible so authenticity feels credible rather than overly staged.
strategic_value: A cropped person holding a burger can connect Burger King’s heritage claim with an ordinary eating moment.
demonstration: Brown copy on yellow occupies the left while a person in a denim jacket holding a burger fills the right.
practical_value: Assess whether photography feels human and unforced instead of rigidly perfected.

content_islands.name: Principle copy
content_islands.spec: Set the authenticity statement at left under the numbered heading.

content_islands.name: Human crop
content_islands.spec: Crop the person at the torso on the right, retaining the hand, jacket, shirt graphic and burger.

reference_purposes.Intent: The paragraph links the principle to heritage, people, food and acceptance of imperfections.
reference_purposes.Expression: The photograph shows a casually dressed person holding the food rather than an isolated product.

ingredient.name: Authentic human imagery
ingredient.role: Make the food experience feel familiar and human.
ingredient.application: Avoid rigid or overly crafted presentation; allow imperfections.
ingredient.scope: Stated Proudly True principle in this historical partner guide.
